chunks: Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated to us, he said: Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Zakariya al-Qattan narrated to us, he said: Bakr ibn Abdullah ibn Habib narrated to us, he said: Tamim ibn Buhlul narrated to us, from his father, from Abu al-Hasan al-Abdi, from Sulayman ibn Mahran, from 'Ubayah, from Ibn Abbas, who said:
I asked him about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: 'Did He not find you an orphan and give you refuge?'
He said: He was only named an orphan because he did not have any equal on the face of the earth from the first ones nor from the last ones.
So Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He, said, bestowing favor upon him with His grace: 'Did He not find you an orphan?'
Meaning: Lonely, there is no equal to you.
'And gave you refuge' — He gathered the people to you and made them know your virtue, until they came to know you.
'And found you astray' — He is saying: Among your people, you were attributed to aberration, and so He guided them to knowing you.
'And found you poor' — He is saying: Poor according to your people, as they say: You have no money.
And then Allah enriched you with the wealth of Khadija, and then He increased you from His favor and made your supplication responded to.
That even if you were to supplicate that a stone is made by Allah into gold, His gaze would turn to your wish.
And He brought to you food where there was no food, and He brought you water where there was no water, and He succored you with Angels where there was no succorer.
And He granted you victory over your enemies through them.

key_terms.خَدِيجَةَ: Khadija (the Prophet's wife, source of his initial wealth)
key_terms.يَتِيمًا: Orphan (interpreted here as having no equal/peer)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the Prophet being called an 'orphan' in Surah Ad-Duha according to Ibn Abbas?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, Ibn Abbas interprets 'yateem' (orphan) in Surah Ad-Duha not merely as parental loss but as a unique ontological status, signifying the Prophet had no peer among the first and last generations. The text highlights divine favor through material enrichment via Khadija, the acceptance of his supplications, and the provision of sustenance and angels, illustrating the transition from worldly poverty to spiritual and communal supremacy.

en.basel-kadem: 4.	We were told by Ahmad bin Hasan al-Qattan, that he said: We were told by Ahmad bin Yahya bin Zakariya al-Qattan, that he said: We were told by Bikr bin Abdullah bin Habib, that he said: We were told by Tamim bin Buhlul, from his father, from Abu’l-Hasan al-‘Abdi, from Sulayman bin Mahran, from ‘Abaya, from Ibn Abbas, that he said:
I asked him about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «Did He not find you an orphan, and give you refuge?» [93:6]
He said: He was only named an orphan because he did not have any equal on the face of earth from the first, neither from the last,
to which Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He, said, bestowing favor upon him with His grace: «Did He not find you an orphan, and give you refuge?» [93:6]
meaning: Lonely, there is no equal to you,
and then He gave the people refuge to towards you and made them know your virtue, until they came to know you.
«And He found you astray» [93:7] He is saying: Among your people, you were attributed to aberration, and so He guided them to knowing you.
«And He found you poor» [93:8] He is saying: Poor according to your people, as they say: You have no money,
and then Allah enriched you with the money of Khadija, and then He increased you from His favor and made your prayer responded to,
that even if you were to supplicate that a stone is made by Allah into gold, He would achieve your wish,
and He brought to you food as there was no food, and He brought you water as there was no water, and He succored you with Angels as there was no succorer,
and He granted you victory over your enemies.
